deterministic_replay.old_rule: maximum absolute and relative difference must both be exactly zero
deterministic_replay.new_rule: For every parsed value, abs(primary-replay) must be no greater than 1e-12 + 1e-12 * max(1, abs(replay)).
deterministic_replay.rationale: This remains at least one thousand times tighter in relative scale than the primary LSODA relative tolerance of 1e-9, while separating floating-point process-launch variation from a scientifically material replay failure.
deterministic_replay.reporting: Record maximum absolute difference, maximum scale-normalized difference, and maximum fraction of the allowed difference for each artifact. Do not use the term bit-identical unless both maxima are exactly zero.
